problem: Browser Navigate rejected ordinary navigation and displayed login error
observable_evidence: visible UI showed expired-token message and about:blank
hypothesis_summary: UI request and auth-error handling violate backend approval contract
chosen_action: Remove self-approval flag; treat only HTTP 401 as session expiry
why_this_action: Ordinary navigation already has server-side policy; 403 is an action refusal

verification.independent: Parent exercised visible UI after worker tests
verification.title: Example Domain

reusable_lesson: Policy refusals must preserve authenticated UI state; never invent approval flags

problem: OpenRouter key field rendered without Connect button
observable_evidence: Visible UI had API KEY only
appendChild called with three child arguments
hypothesis_summary: DOM appendChild accepts only one child
chosen_action: Use append for field, hint and button
why_this_action: Preserves all intended children and the existing backend flow

verification.independent: Parent clicked actual Connect with authorized temporary key

reusable_lesson: Verify rendered controls and actual backend action; source presence alone is insufficient

observable_evidence: Legacy token header did not supersede session CSRF
Same-session CSRF header enabled provider creation
hypothesis_summary: QA client did not reproduce application authentication contract
chosen_action: Use current session CSRF header and normal UI Connect
why_this_action: Exercise existing authenticated flow without weakening it
tests_run: actual provider creation and UI connection
reusable_lesson: Do not classify a missing CSRF header in the test harness as a product bug

problem: Approval and restart continuity for a requested git push
observable_evidence: approval digest persisted across server restart
UI rejection changed tool call to rejected
hypothesis_summary: Durable approval state should survive process restart without executing the effect
chosen_action: Restart Command Center while approval was pending, then reject via UI
why_this_action: Tests persistence and exactly-zero execution on rejection
reusable_lesson: Persist approval plus digest before stopping execution; resume must not replay the guarded effect

problem: Bossman marked an honestly reported failed file mutation as completed
observable_evidence: project_host denied cwd outside allowed root
model response explicitly said success cannot be confirmed
hypothesis_summary: The task wording bypassed action-contract evidence and generic final text was treated as completion
chosen_action: Expand terminal-file imperative classification and exclude dotted tool names from filename evidence
why_this_action: Attach deterministic file evidence for ordinary use/write wording without inventing a terminal.run file
reusable_lesson: A model's honest failure text must not become task completion; derive concrete evidence before execution

problem: Approved safe file mutation failed in Windows project-host shell
observable_evidence: nested python -c command became unterminated string
file evidence failed because glm_acceptance.txt was absent
hypothesis_summary: Nested shell quoting corrupted the command before Python execution
chosen_action: Stop task and checkpoint; next attempt must use an argv-safe/simple command
why_this_action: Avoid repeating an equivalent failed command and prevent paid review retries
tests_run: live tool call plus independent file reopen
reusable_lesson: On Windows, do not embed a quote-heavy Python program inside a shell command when a simpler argv-safe operation exists
